svg.title: Recent AI-coded mathematical claims by assigned taxonomy v0.2 category and completion-envelope tiers
svg.desc: 1239 claim rows from 1237 source-included packages. Assigned corpus totals: 0 Expected, 53 Difficult, 47 Superhuman and 1139 incomplete. Each incomplete claim remains one outlined block with one flat 50% translucent fill: a pure tier colour for one destination or the average tier colour for an ambiguous envelope. The exact permitted challenge-evidence destinations remain in each block title and data attribute. These tiers concern completion of challenge-evidence coding, not proof verification. Only the latest seven populated months are drawn.
